name: Appointment reminders and waitlist
summary: Finds upcoming appointments that Cliniko sent no reminder for and drafts the text to send by hand, turns cancelled appointments into waitlist offers, and queues a booking for a waitlisted patient once a person has marked them accepted. Crons read and draft; a person approves every booking.

reminders.evidence: 3 discovery calls read (2 describe the process; a pharmacy and a wellness clinic); Cliniko help pages read step by step

covered_by.booking-made: skill (staff book in Cliniko; the crons only read it)

crons.name: reminders
crons.summary: Upcoming appointments with no reminder sent by Cliniko: draft the reminder text for a person to send.

crons.name: cancellations
crons.summary: Cancelled appointments still ahead: record the opening and draft the waitlist offer text.

crons.name: waitlist-book
crons.summary: Openings a person marked accepted and still free: queue the booking for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. The crons write drafts and openings to their own store, never to Cliniko. Booking a patient into a slot changes the appointment book, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

cliniko.covers: appointment list (reminder gaps, cancellations, slot re-check) and the approved booking; reminder and SMS sends stay in Cliniko

gaps: Cliniko has no API operation for reminders, SMS sends or the wait list. Reminders stay on Cliniko's own templates; the crons only find the gaps and draft text.
Patient replies such as 'Reply Y to confirm' are forwarded to a practitioner's phone or email, and the docs do not say they are recorded on the appointment. Confirmation handling is not automated.
Nothing in the CRM shell yet records that a waitlisted patient accepted an opening. The waitlist-book cron has nothing to queue until a person can set an opening to accepted.
HotDoc: its reminders and online confirm are well documented, but the kit has no HotDoc ops file, so no adapter is built.
Jane App: the kit's one mapped operation (List Appointments) points at treatments, not appointments, so no adapter is built.
GoHighLevel: the calls say it sends the reminders and holds the bookings, but it is not in this workflow's platform evidence, so it is not built here.

Runtime change needed: core/sdk/call.ts sends every array parameter as one JSON string, so Cliniko's repeated date-range filter cannot be sent. The adapter sends the start filter only, checks the end in code, and refuses a book of more than 1,000 future appointments rather than reading part of it.
The Cliniko adapter is tested on a fake network only. Field names come from Cliniko's docs pages, and the cancelled-appointment read is unverified on a live account.

Runtime change needed: a waitlist booking is queued after the slot is checked, but the approval can run hours later, after someone else has booked the slot. The approval path (core/workflows/runtime.ts) would need to re-read the slot before the create runs, or the live slot state shown in the approval summary. Not built here, so a double booking is possible until then.
Evidence is thin: three calls, two of them describing the process, and no waitlist call at all. The waitlist steps come from Cliniko's help pages, not from owners.

evidence.calls: 3 health-care discovery calls read for reminders (pharmacy, wellness clinic); 2 describe the process
evidence.platforms: Cliniko, HotDoc and Jane App help pages mapped step by step; only Cliniko has mapped operations for these steps
